children.title: Robust Proxy Optimization and Evaluator Alignment

detail.title: Robust Proxy Optimization and Evaluator Alignment
detail.summary: Autonomous systems can mitigate reward hacking by combining robust max-min policy optimization over correlated proxy spaces with invariance-based stress testing that isolates exploitable sensitivities from genuine performance gains.
detail.reason: Revision incorporating new confirmatory evidence for robust policy optimization.
